title: RAG Evaluation Survey
content: RAG evaluation should report retrieval quality and citation grounding. Evidence links help readers audit generated claims. Systems that only emit a final paragraph without source quotes are hard to trust in research workflows.

title: Citation Mapping for Research Assistants
content: Citation mapping connects every report claim to a quote, source URI, and paper title. A claim without evidence is an unsupported claim. Local fixtures make citation checks deterministic for teaching and tests.

title: Agent Memory Notes
content: Memory records can pollute an agent when write policy is missing. Skill packages should load progressively: first the SKILL.md summary, then only the references a task actually needs. Offline memory and skill contracts keep repeated research sessions inspectable.

title: Delegation Budgets for Multi-Agent Research
content: Child agents need isolated context and explicit budgets. Parent runs should record delegate_start and delegate_finish events so reviewers can audit who did which subtask. Unlimited child steps make multi-agent research hard to reproduce.
